title: Union Grove Volunteer Fire District 16 — Monthly fire-service fee
officialQuestion:
LOCAL REFERENDUM UNION GROVE
VFD 16
Do you favor the assessment of a fire
service fee in the amount of $5.00
(dollars) a month for the purpose of
funding fire protection services in this
volunteer fire district?
YES
NO

explainer.whatItDoes: Authorizes a $5 monthly fire-service fee to fund fire protection in Union Grove Volunteer Fire District 16.
explainer.yesMeans: A YES vote approves the $5 monthly fire-service fee.
explainer.noMeans: A NO vote rejects the proposed fee.

requiredScope: Union Grove Volunteer Fire District16. Neither Union Grove municipality nor Marshall County is a substitute. No reader contest is installed until exact territory is supported.
